name: opened boxes collect rewards keys and discovered descendants once
input: a nested catalog with two staged keys
test:
boxes = [
    Box('root', 2, ('brass',), ('side',)),
    Box('side', 5, ('silver',), ('chest',)),
    Box('chest', 11, (), ()),
]
assert get_max_candies(boxes, {'root'}, {'brass': 'side', 'silver': 'chest'}) == 18

name: an early key waits until a later parent discovers its target
input: a target unlocked before its child reference is exposed
test:
boxes = [
    Box('root', 1, ('open-side', 'open-chest'), ('side',)),
    Box('side', 3, (), ('chest',)),
    Box('chest', 7, (), ()),
]
assert get_max_candies(boxes, {'root'}, {'open-side': 'side', 'open-chest': 'chest'}) == 11

name: cycles repeated references locked boxes and unknown keys are safe
input: a cycle plus a child that has no unlocking key
test:
boxes = [
    Box('root', 1, ('open-side', 'unknown'), ('side', 'side', 'locked')),
    Box('side', 4, (), ('root',)),
    Box('locked', 100, (), ()),
]
assert get_max_candies(boxes, {'root'}, {'open-side': 'side', 'unknown': 'not-in-catalog'}) == 5
